description: Clustered residential electricity load profiles from Smart Grid Smart City dataset is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Mike Roberts. This dataset contains 30-minute interval electricity load data for 6031 residential customers in NEW South Wales for the calendar year 2013. The original data was collected for the the AusGrid Smart Grid Smart Cities (SGSC) project and made publicly available. (Smart Grid Smart City Customer Trial Data. 2014; http://www.data.gov.au. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2019. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
